policy: CNN stops at the first full-training evaluation reaching 80%, then its trunk AND classification head remain frozen. Training continues only in error-correction children and signed correction strengths. Predeclared width/depth grid; test scores never select CNN checkpoints, determine growth or select repeat depths. Depth extensions reuse identical existing base networks and tasks, add deeper children and refit strengths. Natural topology/parameter plateaus and optimization limits are reported. Test curves are exploratory repeated measurements on the original test splits already used in Version 1. No guaranteed double descent.
